title.zh: Solidus Labs 指 Hyperliquid 原油永续合约出现逾1.7亿美元异常订单，涉嫌幌骗
title.en: Bloomberg: Over $170M in Unusual Hyperliquid Oil Perp Orders Raise Spoofing Susp

current_state.zh: Solidus Labs analysis published October 29 alleges a trader used two Hyperliquid accounts to place over $170 million in anomalous crude oil perpetual orders — repeatedly cancelling large quotes while filling on the opposite side at roughly a 30:1 ratio — netting about $119,000 over three days, conduct it says matches spoofing though intent is unproven, while Hyperliquid notes all order and trade records are public on-chain.
